summary: Replayed the already-approved, independently audited Batch 3E Simian Line module move onto current main as a fresh bounded implementation, per the PP-RELAY-005 task packet, rather than merging the stale feat/curriculum-wave-3e-3f branch. Moved src/content/lessons/lines/06-simian-line.mdx to src/content/lessons/advanced/simian-line.mdx (route /learn/advanced/simian-line/), now the fourth lesson of Minor Lines & Synthesis (order: 4, difficulty: intermediate); bumped advanced/04-how-to-give-a-reading.mdx to order: 5 to stay collision-free. Replaced the lesson's now-false 'taught in this module' line-quality self-reference with a link to line-quality-and-markings. Preserved the old /learn/lines/06-simian-line/ URL with a new noindex, follow stub page that canonicalizes and meta-refreshes to the new route, added to the indexability noindex allowlist (excluded from sitemap/Pagefind) and exempted from the lesson-schema requirement in the schema audit. Added an optional canonicalPath override prop to BaseHead.astro for the stub only; every other caller is unaffected. Repointed the three direct internal references to the old lesson URL (simian-line.md relatedLesson, the m-line-palmistry.md inline link, and the glossary entry) and updated the Lines/Advanced module descriptions in consts.ts. Updated canonical docs to correct a stale note that PP-RELAY-004 was unmerged (it merged via PR #17) and to record the 3E Simian move as shipped. No Sun/Mercury rewrite or other 3F content/practice work was touched; the stale branch was not merged, rebased, or cherry-picked.
